title: Continuous Scale Navigation
summary: A scroll-driven interaction path that carries the view from galaxy scale through stellar systems and worlds toward a planetary surface.
body: This product artifact keeps scale changes reversible and continuous while reusing the existing YEIS navigation and world-rendering authority.

zh.title: 连续尺度导航
zh.summary: 一条由滚轮驱动的连续交互路径，从银河尺度进入恒星系与星球，并继续逼近星球表面。
zh.body: 该产品能力保持尺度切换连续、可逆，同时继续复用现有 YEIS 导航与世界渲染权威。
